title: TikTok Shop US product listing compliance guidance

statements.text: Product titles, descriptions, images, categories, and variations should be clear, truthful, accurate, and consistent with the product being listed. Include applicable essential specifications, warnings, or restrictions and verify the current official policy before publishing.
no_answer_when: the current category requirement cannot be verified

statements.text: Do not use misleading claims, an incorrect category, duplicate listings, or content that redirects a customer to complete the transaction off-platform. If a category may require qualification or approval, provide the official source link and escalate for compliance review.
no_answer_when: qualification or approval status cannot be verified

statements.text: This content explains listing compliance only. It is not a source for a specific seller's SKU dimensions, materials, inventory, price, certification, or after-sales attributes. Those facts require authorized seller product data in a shop-private space; otherwise return no evidence or escalate for manual review.
no_answer_when: the request asks for a specific SKU fact without an authorized shop-private source
